evals.prompt: Create a 16:9 widescreen HTML presentation using Tailwind CSS explaining a multi-agent orchestration architecture.
evals.expected_output: A single-file HTML document formatted in 16:9 aspect ratio using Tailwind CSS, Inter/JetBrains Mono fonts, and technical cards.
assertions: Enforces 16:9 widescreen layout (e.g. aspect-video or 1920x1080 dimensions)
Includes Tailwind CSS styling with Slate base and Indigo accents
Uses Inter font for typography and JetBrains Mono for code or technical badges
Slide outputs are co-located in the target presentation directory

evals.prompt: Convert a slide presentation HTML document into high-resolution PNG slides and compile them into PDF/PPTX decks.
evals.expected_output: Execution plan or command invocation using scripts/generate_png.py and scripts/compile_presentation.py.
assertions: Invokes Playwright-based screenshot renderer for pixel-perfect capture
Uses compile_presentation.py to generate both PDF and 16:9 widescreen PPTX outputs
Co-locates all compiled presentation artifacts alongside the outline source
